name: muldhon
description: Muldhon investment platform — React client + Express API deployed as one Vercel project
//: vercel-build is what @vercel/static-build runs (see vercel.json). It installs the client's own dependencies first, because Vercel only installs THIS package.json's dependencies — those are the API's, and they are what the api/index.js function gets bundled with. --include=dev is belt-and-braces: it keeps the build working even if NODE_ENV=production is set on the project, which is what makes npm skip build tools and produce 'vite: command not found'.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
